tools.name: search_birth_place
tools.description: Search Xiaodao’s place catalogue for birth place IDs, Chinese and English names, countries and first-level administrative areas. Select the intended place; its stored coordinates and historical time zone rules are used by the calculation tools, not today’s UTC offset.
